verdict: Organic channels are carrying all activity; paid ads remain paused.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your business ran entirely on organic visibility — paid advertising on Meta and Google was dark, so there was no paid spend, cost per lead, or paid leads to report. Your Google Business Profile drove 98 total actions in that window, including 22 calls and 38 direction requests, but GBP engagement has dropped 44% in the most recent 7 days, which is the main risk heading into next week. Instagram reach grew 29.54% week-over-week and reached 32,721 people this period, though that activity has not yet translated into tracked leads. We are focused on stabilizing GBP visibility and ensuring incoming interest is captured as pipeline before it goes unrecorded.
